summary: Consume canonical allocator workspaces without duplicate creation

delivery.outcome: Consume the real Worktrees v5 allocation exactly once, validate its registered canonical workspace, and retain an explicit controller-admission handoff before any implementation edits. Bind failed or interrupted preparation to the original allocation instead of creating duplicate worktrees or fake leases. First bounded slice of PLF-100 / #565.
nonGoals: Implement the protected controller adapter or grant write authority from an allocation lease
Queue execution and promotion (active ticket-329 owns queue/**)
Apply or discard PLF-031 stashes; modify main-only exception or protected merge policy

architecture.decision: Read and validate allocator-owned workspace and lease records. Preserve allocation identity in a local run journal. Stop governed execution with a structured admission-required error until independent controller admission is implemented; do not manufacture ownership.

dataChanges.description: Add allocation identity and admission blocker to the existing ignored local execution journal; no migration or cross-component ownership transfer.

architecture.rollback: Revert the material ticket commit; preserve all allocator reservations and worktrees.

validation.evidence: Real managed allocator/checker and Git: single canonical linked allocation, scope and base bindings, no remote fetch or synthetic lease; dirty/invalid/symlink inputs rejected; controller handoff persisted and replay disabled.
Managed gate, focused stack checks and independent protected delivery.
